title: Interpretable Difficulty-Aware Knowledge Tracing in Tutor-Student Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2605.01097v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the development of AI-powered tutoring systems that provide interactive support via dialogue. To enable these tutoring systems to provide personalized support, it is essential to assess student performance at each turn, motivating knowledge tracing (KT) in dialogue settings. However, existing dialogue-based KT approaches often ignore question difficulty modeling and rely on opaque latent representations from LLMs, hindering accurate and interpretable prediction. In this work, we propose an interpretable difficulty-aware conversational KT framework built upon LLMs, which explicitly models students' abilities and the difficulty of tutor-posed tasks at each turn. The framework incorporates the original textual question and the next tutor-posed task to estimate the student's knowledge state and the difficulty of the upcoming turn. translated_title: 师生对话中可解释的难度感知知识追踪
translated_abstract: 近年来大语言模型（LLM）的进展催生了通过对话提供交互式支持的AI辅助教学系统。为了让这些教学系统能够提供个性化支持，必须在每一轮对话中评估学生的表现，这推动了对话场景下知识追踪（KT）的研究。然而，现有的基于对话的知识追踪方法往往忽略了对题目难度的建模，并且依赖于LLM不透明的潜在表示，阻碍了准确且可解释的预测。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于LLM的可解释的难度感知对话式知识追踪框架，该框架在每一轮对话中显式地建模学生的能力和教师布置任务的难度。该框架结合原始文本题目和教师下一步布置的任务，来估计学生的知识状态以及即将到来的对话轮次的难度。此外，该框架还融合了项目反应理论（IRT）……
tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的可解释的难度感知对话式知识追踪框架，在每轮对话中显式建模学生能力与教师任务难度，从而实现更准确、更可解释的知识状态预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable difficulty-aware conversational knowledge tracing framework built on LLMs, which explicitly models student ability and tutor-posed task difficulty at each turn to enable more accurate and interpretable prediction.
